entries.title: Psalms 27:1
segments: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Jehovah is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? Jehovah is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

entries.title: Psalms 27:2
segments: When evil-doers, mine adversaries and mine enemies, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.

entries.title: Psalms 27:3
segments: If a host encamp against me, my heart shall not fear; if war rise against me, in this will I be confident.

entries.title: Psalms 27:4
segments: One [thing] have I asked of Jehovah, that will I seek after: that I may dwell in the house of Jehovah all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of Jehovah, and to inquire [of him] in his temple.

entries.title: Psalms 27:5
segments: For in the day of evil he will hide me in his pavilion; in the secret of his tent will he keep me concealed: he will set me high upon a rock.

entries.title: Psalms 27:6
segments: And now shall my head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me; and I will offer in his tent sacrifices of shouts of joy: I will sing, yea, I will sing psalms unto Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 27:7
segments: ¶Hear, Jehovah; with my voice do I call; be gracious unto me, and answer me.

entries.title: Psalms 27:8
segments: My heart said for thee, Seek ye my face. Thy face, O Jehovah, will I seek.

entries.title: Psalms 27:9
segments: Hide not thy face from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; cast me not off, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 27:10
segments: For had my father and my mother forsaken me, then had Jehovah taken me up.

entries.title: Psalms 27:11
segments: Teach me thy way, Jehovah, and lead me in an even path, because of mine enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 27:12
segments: Deliver me not over to the will of mine adversaries; for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out violence.

entries.title: Psalms 27:13
segments: Unless I had believed to see the goodness of Jehovah in the land of the living...!

entries.title: Psalms 27:14
segments: Wait for Jehovah; be strong and let thy heart take courage: yea, wait for Jehovah.
